name: PETRONM
recent: PETRONM 在 2026 年 11 月 26 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩，并有多项高层人事变动，包括两名主要官员及一名董事兼审计委员会成员的变动。公司亦于 9 月 18 日更改注册地址。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。
两名主要官员 MR MARK TRISTAN D. CAPARAS 及 MR BRIAN R. OCAMPO 发生职务变动。
MISS YEE PEK MEI 卸任董事及审计委员会成员职务。

recent_en: PETRONM released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 26 November 2026, alongside several senior personnel changes involving two principal officers and one director who also sits on the audit committee. The company also changed its registered address on 18 September.
notable_en: Announced consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
Changes in principal officers for MR MARK TRISTAN D. CAPARAS and MR BRIAN R. OCAMPO.
MISS YEE PEK MEI ceased to be a director and audit committee member.
